reason: The CIFs parse and symmetry-expand as stated (primitive P31m, a=4.70679 A, c=11.53008 A, Z=1, 12 fully occupied atoms, RbIn(WO4)2), and the trace provides strong indexing plus instantiated whole-profile fits (Rwp about 8.28-8.29%). However, neither submitted realization passes decisive periodic chemistry checks. In selected.cif every W has no O closer than 2.935 A and has an expected-valence bond-valence sum of only about 0.20 for nominal W6+; In is also severely underbonded (about 0.61 versus +3), while Rb has three anomalously short 2.202 A O contacts. alternative-1.cif likewise has no W-O contact below 3.078 A (W bond-valence sum about 0.15) and has repeated impossible 1.552-1.608 A O-O overlaps. Complete neighbor shells confirm these are not cutoff artifacts. Thus the low profile residual was obtained for chemically impossible atomic minima, so no sufficiently established exact structure is present and another search is likely to add a materially different viable realization.
